items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The one with Wingy Manone? ... Wingy went up to Harlem the night before, sat down with some arranger, and sang the themes to him. Then we got to the date.

ctx.x: Just before we get into the band starting, there’s one record session that you made which has always intrigued me. It’s just a small group, which had . . .
Wingy Manone, with Jelly Roll Morton on piano.
